api/bifrost.py.name: Workflow import shortcuts
api/bifrost.py.description: Lets workflow code import Bifrost helpers by short, friendly names instead of long internal paths.

api/bifrost/__init__.py.name: Platform toolkit for code
api/bifrost/__init__.py.description: Gives workflow code ready-made access to agents, AI answers, files, tables, forms, people and settings.

api/bifrost/__main__.py.name: Terminal entry point
api/bifrost/__main__.py.description: Starts the Bifrost terminal tool when someone launches it from a script.

api/bifrost/_context.py.name: Run context
api/bifrost/_context.py.description: Keeps track of which run, organization and permission scope the current piece of workflow code is acting for.

api/bifrost/_device_auth.py.name: Browser sign-in prompt
api/bifrost/_device_auth.py.description: Shows the short code and browser link that let someone approve a terminal sign-in from another device.

api/bifrost/_execution_context.py.name: Run and organization details
api/bifrost/_execution_context.py.description: Holds the organization, caller, event details and savings tracking that every workflow run receives.

api/bifrost/_logging.py.name: Live run logs
api/bifrost/_logging.py.description: Streams messages to anyone watching a run, keeps them for the live view and saves them into the run's history.

api/bifrost/_refreshing.py.name: Sign-in renewal
api/bifrost/_refreshing.py.description: Quietly renews an expired sign-in and retries the request so long sessions keep working.

api/bifrost/_runtime_io.py.name: Runtime activity feed
api/bifrost/_runtime_io.py.description: Sends log lines from running code back over the same signed-in connection the rest of the tool uses.

api/bifrost/_service_runtime.py.name: Always-on service control
api/bifrost/_service_runtime.py.description: Lets a long-running service announce it is ready, notice a stop request and shut down cleanly.

api/bifrost/_solution_workspace.py.name: Solution folder guard
api/bifrost/_solution_workspace.py.description: Stops whole-workspace commands from running inside a single Solution's folder, where they would do the wrong thing.

api/bifrost/_version_notice.py.name: Update reminder
api/bifrost/_version_notice.py.description: Shows the new-version-available note once per version instead of on every command.

api/bifrost/_workspace_lock.py.name: Workspace lock
api/bifrost/_workspace_lock.py.description: Stops two terminals from syncing or watching the same workspace at the same time.

api/bifrost/agents.py.name: Agent calls from code
api/bifrost/agents.py.description: Lets workflow code start an agent and read back its answer, its pauses or its progress.

api/bifrost/ai.py.name: AI answers from code
api/bifrost/ai.py.description: Lets workflow code ask the organization's configured AI providers for answers without handling keys itself.

api/bifrost/api.py.name: Direct request helper
api/bifrost/api.py.description: Gives advanced scripts a signed-in way to call any part of the platform directly.

api/bifrost/app_binding.py.name: App project link
api/bifrost/app_binding.py.description: Remembers which Bifrost app a local app project belongs to, so running and deploying reach the right one.

api/bifrost/app_migration.py.name: App upgrade from v1
api/bifrost/app_migration.py.description: Rewrites an older app's code into the newer project layout during an upgrade.

api/bifrost/artifacts.py.name: Generated file sharing
api/bifrost/artifacts.py.description: Creates, reads and shares files a workflow produces, such as reports, exports and documents.

api/bifrost/cli.py.name: Bifrost command
api/bifrost/cli.py.description: The main Bifrost command: sign in, run and push code, deploy Solutions and call the platform from a terminal.

api/bifrost/client.py.name: Platform connection
api/bifrost/client.py.description: Handles the signed-in connection to a Bifrost site, including sign-in, pass renewal and clear error messages.

api/bifrost/config.py.name: Settings access
api/bifrost/config.py.description: Reads and writes the platform's stored settings from workflow code.

api/bifrost/contract_version.py.name: Compatibility version
api/bifrost/contract_version.py.description: Reports which older command-line versions the server still accepts.

api/bifrost/credentials.py.name: Saved sign-ins
api/bifrost/credentials.py.description: Stores one sign-in per Bifrost address, using the operating system's password vault where possible.

api/bifrost/decorator_validation.py.name: Workflow declaration checks
api/bifrost/decorator_validation.py.description: Checks that a workflow's declared settings are valid before the platform tries to run it.

api/bifrost/decorators.py.name: Workflow and tool labels
api/bifrost/decorators.py.description: Marks a function as a workflow, an AI tool, a data feed or a long-running service, and records what it offers.

api/bifrost/definition_validation.py.name: Workspace file checks
api/bifrost/definition_validation.py.description: Reads workspace definition files strictly and reports clear problems with duplicate or unknown settings.

api/bifrost/dto_flags.py.name: Command option builder
api/bifrost/dto_flags.py.description: Builds command options and request contents from the same shared shape the server expects, keeping terminal and AI access in step.

api/bifrost/events.py.name: Event publishing
api/bifrost/events.py.description: Lets workflow code announce an event that other workflows and subscriptions can react to.

api/bifrost/executions.py.name: Run history
api/bifrost/executions.py.description: Lists past runs and opens one run's details and log lines.

api/bifrost/field_classes.py.name: Shared field metadata
api/bifrost/field_classes.py.description: Tags each shared setting with how it should be treated when a workspace is exported or installed elsewhere.

api/bifrost/files.py.name: Workspace files
api/bifrost/files.py.description: Reads, writes, moves, lists and deletes workspace files, with clear errors when access is refused.

api/bifrost/forms.py.name: Form lookup
api/bifrost/forms.py.description: Looks up forms and their questions from workflow code.

api/bifrost/git_commands.py.name: Source control commands
api/bifrost/git_commands.py.description: Mirrors the app's source-control panel in the terminal: fetch, status, commit, sync, resolve conflicts and discard changes.

api/bifrost/ignore_patterns.py.name: Skipped file patterns
api/bifrost/ignore_patterns.py.description: Lists which files and folders are left out when a workspace is uploaded or packaged.

api/bifrost/integrations.py.name: Integration access
api/bifrost/integrations.py.description: Reads and manages the outside services an organization has connected.

api/bifrost/knowledge.py.name: Knowledge search
api/bifrost/knowledge.py.description: Searches the organization's knowledge base and returns the matching passages.

api/bifrost/manifest_codec.py.name: Settings file conversion
api/bifrost/manifest_codec.py.description: Converts workspace settings between their file form and the records the platform stores.

api/bifrost/manifest.py.name: Workspace definition files
api/bifrost/manifest.py.description: Describes every kind of entity a workspace's settings files can hold, from workflows and forms to integrations.

api/bifrost/migrate_imports.py.name: App code upgrade
api/bifrost/migrate_imports.py.description: Rewrites older app imports, icons and component usage into the current app format.
